scope: Proposition 3.7 (Fusion as a counting tensor-fibre bundle) of the manuscript “The arithmetic category and stable recovery of lattice factors” (preprints/The-arithmetic-category-and-stable-recovery-of-lattice-factors-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5a2107e608fdff7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a unitary correspon- dence identification (3.18) HX ¯ ⊗N HY ∼ = HZ under which outer transport is Equation (3.17). The space Z has finitely many outer-group orbits. For each z = [(x, y)], its stabilizer is a finite-index subgroup-isomorphism graph with germ dydx. Regrouping these orbits over full stabilizers by Equation (3.8) gives the full-germ decomposition of the fusion.
